caption: This drawing features an ornate armchair with a high, intricate, dark-colored wooden frame and legs, along with padded areas on the chair back, seat, and armrests upholstered in a rich pink fabric. The chair back has a tufted pattern, and the wood is elaborately carved into flowing, decorative designs. The seat and armrests have a smooth, plush appearance, and the legs end in carved feet. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is a square swatch displaying a patterned design in various shades of pink and red, which resembles a textile or wallpaper motif. The background of the drawing is off-white, and there is a signature that reads "Charles Cullen" in cursive in the lower right corner.
title: Armchair
